narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I see it. You add the same number to the top and the bottom.
<bookmark mark='strips'/>Add two to both numbers of two thirds, and you get four fifths. On the same strip, four fifths reaches further.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Four fifths is not the same share as two thirds, so adding does not work.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>To keep a fraction equal, multiply the top and the bottom by the same number.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. How are six tenths and nine fifteenths each made from three fifths?
